name: Doctor of Education
previous: The Doctor of Education at Griffith University is designed for experienced educators and professionals and combines advanced research with practical application, preparing graduates to influence practice, policy and innovation across educational settings including schools, higher education, government and community organisations. Guided by experienced supervisors, students plan and undertake a significant research project addressing contemporary educational issues, building advanced skills in problem-solving, research design and critical inquiry. It runs three years full-time.
description:
The Doctor of Education at Griffith University is designed for experienced educators and professionals and combines advanced research with practical application, preparing graduates to influence practice, policy and innovation across educational settings including schools, higher education, government and community organisations. Guided by experienced supervisors, students plan and undertake a significant research project addressing contemporary educational issues, building advanced skills in problem-solving, research design and critical inquiry. It runs three years full-time.
The Griffith degree code is 6022 (CRICOS 082410C). The degree is worth 240 credit points and takes 3 years full-time, or 6 years part-time (online only). It starts in Trimester 1 or 2, is offered online and at the Logan, Brisbane South and Gold Coast campuses, and requires IELTS Academic 6.5.

name: Doctor of Visual Arts
previous: The Doctor of Visual Arts at Griffith University is a professional development degree with an integrated program of independent research and coursework that helps practising artists extend their studio research and practice and make original conceptual advances in their discipline. Students develop the expertise to provide leadership in their field, along with research skills and the ability to articulate a theoretical position within a visual arts discourse. It runs three to four years full-time at the Queensland College of Art and Design.
description:
The Doctor of Visual Arts at Griffith University is a professional development degree with an integrated program of independent research and coursework that helps practising artists extend their studio research and practice and make original conceptual advances in their discipline. Students develop the expertise to provide leadership in their field, along with research skills and the ability to articulate a theoretical position within a visual arts discourse. It runs three to four years full-time at the Queensland College of Art and Design.
The Griffith degree code is 6009 (CRICOS 062441F). The degree is worth 240 credit points and takes 3 to 4 years full-time at the Brisbane City campus, starting in Trimester 1 or 2. It requires IELTS Academic 6.5.
